note: Synthetic, hand-written bilingual eval: 30 topics, each target with a same-language confuser; per target a paraphrase, a cross-language and a keyword query. Authored, so biased -- use it to COMPARE configurations, not as an absolute quality claim. 'exact' queries quote literal numbers/phrases (where lexical matching matters).

travel_reimb.text: 出差报销规定：住宿标准一线城市每晚不超过600元，其他城市450元。高铁二等座和经济舱机票可全额报销，需在返程后十个工作日内提交行程单和发票。

travel_reimb__confuser.text: 办公用品申领流程：员工在内网填写申领单，部门经理审批后由行政部统一采购，每月五号集中发放。

laptop_warranty.text: Laptop warranty policy: company notebooks are covered for three years including accidental damage. Report a broken screen or keyboard to IT within 48 hours and a loaner device is issued the same day.

laptop_warranty__confuser.text: Mobile phone allowance: employees in sales roles receive a monthly stipend of 50 dollars towards their personal phone plan, paid with the regular salary.

reservoir.text: 水文报告：今年八月持续干旱，城北水库水位跌至建库以来最低点，蓄水量不足设计库容的两成，自来水公司已启动分时段供水。

reservoir__confuser.text: 防汛预案：每年六月至九月为主汛期，河道管理处二十四小时值班，暴雨红色预警时沿河低洼地区居民需在两小时内转移。

onboarding.text: New hire onboarding checklist: on day one collect your badge from reception, set up two-factor authentication, and complete the mandatory security awareness course before you are given access to customer data.

onboarding__confuser.text: Annual performance review: managers schedule a one-hour conversation in December covering goals achieved, feedback from peers, and the salary adjustment for next year.

contract_renewal.text: 供应商合同续签：现有服务器维保合同将于明年三月到期，法务部要求提前九十天启动续签谈判，新合同需增加数据泄露的违约赔偿条款。

contract_renewal__confuser.text: 采购招标公告：本次招标采购五十台办公台式机，投标截止日期为下月十五日，开标地点在公司三楼会议室。

api_latency.text: Postmortem: the checkout API slowed down because a missing database index forced full table scans. After adding a composite index on order id and status, p99 latency dropped from 2.3 seconds to 140 milliseconds.

api_latency__confuser.text: Release notes 4.2: the mobile app gains dark mode, a redesigned settings page, and support for paying with gift cards at checkout.

maternity.text: 产假政策：女职工生育享受一百五十八天产假，难产增加十五天，多胞胎每多一个婴儿增加十五天；配偶享受十五天陪产假，期间工资照常发放。

maternity__confuser.text: 年休假规定：工作满一年不满十年的员工每年享有五天带薪年假，满十年不满二十年的享有十天，未休年假可顺延至次年第一季度。

phishing.text: Security alert: attackers are sending emails that imitate our payroll provider and ask staff to confirm bank details on a fake login page. Never enter your password from an email link; report the message with the phish button.

phishing__confuser.text: Password policy update: passwords must be at least fourteen characters and are no longer forced to expire every ninety days, following current NIST guidance.

diabetes_diet.text: 糖尿病饮食建议：控制总热量，主食以粗粮为主，少吃精米白面，每餐蔬菜不少于一斤，水果选择升糖指数低的苹果和柚子，并在两餐之间少量进食。

diabetes_diet__confuser.text: 高血压用药须知：降压药需每天固定时间服用，不可擅自停药，服药期间避免大量饮酒，定期测量血压并记录。

garden_tomato.text: Growing tomatoes on a balcony: choose a deep pot, give the plants at least six hours of direct sun, water at the base in the morning, and pinch off side shoots so energy goes into the fruit.

garden_tomato__confuser.text: Caring for indoor orchids: water once a week by soaking the roots for ten minutes, keep them in bright indirect light, and repot every two years in fresh bark.

tax_refund.text: 个人所得税年度汇算：每年三月一日至六月三十日办理，子女教育、赡养老人、住房贷款利息等专项附加扣除未在预扣时享受的，可在汇算时申报退税。

tax_refund__confuser.text: 社保缴费基数调整：每年七月按照上一年度职工月平均工资重新核定缴费基数，单位和个人按比例共同缴纳。

kubernetes_outage.text: Incident report: a misconfigured autoscaler removed all worker nodes in the production Kubernetes cluster during a traffic spike, causing a 37 minute outage of the booking service.

kubernetes_outage__confuser.text: Capacity planning for the holiday season: we expect three times the usual traffic and will pre-provision database replicas two weeks in advance.

wedding_plan.text: 婚礼筹备清单：提前一年预订酒店宴会厅，半年前确定摄影师和婚纱，三个月前发出请柬，婚礼前一周与主持人彩排流程。

wedding_plan__confuser.text: 生日派对布置：准备气球、彩带和蛋糕，提前确认来宾人数，安排一个小游戏环节活跃气氛。

car_insurance.text: Car insurance claim steps: photograph the damage and the other vehicle's plate, exchange insurance details, call the hotline within 24 hours, and get a repair estimate from an approved garage.

car_insurance__confuser.text: Home insurance renewal: the premium rises by eight percent this year; adding a monitored burglar alarm lowers it by five percent.

thesis_format.text: 毕业论文格式要求：正文使用宋体小四号字，行距1.5倍，参考文献按GB/T 7714著录，查重率不得超过百分之十五，答辩前两周提交终稿。

thesis_format__confuser.text: 课程选修指南：每学期选修课不超过三门，选课系统在开学前一周开放，退选需在第二周结束前完成。

solar_panels.text: Rooftop solar proposal: twenty panels producing about 8,000 kilowatt hours per year would cover roughly seventy percent of the building's electricity and pay back the investment in about seven years.

solar_panels__confuser.text: Electric vehicle charging stations: four chargers will be installed in the staff car park; employees pay a flat rate per session through the parking app.

meeting_minutes.text: 项目周会纪要：前端改版延期一周，原因是设计稿第三次修改；后端接口已联调完成；下周二前测试组提交回归测试报告。

meeting_minutes__confuser.text: 团建活动通知：本月二十号组织去郊外徒步，自愿报名，公司承担交通和午餐费用。

gdpr_request.text: Handling a data deletion request: verify the requester's identity, locate their records in the CRM and backups, delete or anonymize them within thirty days, and log the request for the privacy audit.

gdpr_request__confuser.text: Cookie banner update: the website now asks for consent before loading analytics scripts and remembers the choice for six months.

rent_contract.text: 租房合同要点：押一付三，租期两年，租期内房东不得涨租；租客提前退租需提前一个月书面通知，否则押金不予退还。

rent_contract__confuser.text: 物业费通知：小区物业费自明年起调整为每平方米每月二点五元，可按季度或年度缴纳。

marathon.text: Marathon training plan: build up to sixty kilometres per week over sixteen weeks, include one long run every Sunday, and taper during the last three weeks before race day.

marathon__confuser.text: Swimming lessons for beginners: the pool offers ten evening sessions focused on breathing technique and freestyle basics.

cpu_fan.text: 电脑故障排查：笔记本风扇噪音大、机身发烫，多半是散热口积灰，可用压缩空气清理，必要时更换导热硅脂，问题仍在则送修。

cpu_fan__confuser.text: 打印机卡纸处理：关闭电源，打开后盖，顺着进纸方向慢慢抽出纸张，检查是否有碎纸残留后再开机。

customer_churn.text: Churn analysis: customers who did not log in during their first week were four times more likely to cancel within three months, so the onboarding emails will be redesigned around a first-week activation goal.

customer_churn__confuser.text: Pricing experiment: a ten percent discount on annual plans increased conversions slightly but reduced revenue per customer.

visa_japan.text: 日本旅游签证办理：需提供护照原件、近六个月银行流水、在职证明和行程单，经送签旅行社递交，一般七个工作日出签，单次签证停留十五天。

visa_japan__confuser.text: 国内机票退改规则：起飞前七天以上退票收取百分之五手续费，起飞前两小时内退票收取百分之五十。

code_review.text: Code review guidelines: keep pull requests under four hundred lines, explain the why in the description, require one approval from a code owner, and never merge with failing tests.

code_review__confuser.text: Branch naming convention: use feature slash ticket number slash short description, all lowercase with hyphens.

kindergarten.text: 幼儿园入园须知：入园前需完成体检和疫苗接种证明查验，第一周家长可陪同半天，孩子需自带换洗衣物和水杯。

kindergarten__confuser.text: 小学课后托管：放学后在校内托管至下午六点，提供作业辅导，每学期收费一千二百元。

wine_storage.text: Storing wine at home: keep bottles on their side in a dark place at a steady twelve to fourteen degrees Celsius, away from vibration, so the cork stays moist and the wine ages slowly.

wine_storage__confuser.text: Coffee brewing guide: use a medium grind, water just off the boil, and a ratio of one gram of coffee to sixteen grams of water.

earthquake_drill.text: 地震应急演练：警报响起后立即躲到桌下护住头部，震动停止后沿疏散路线有序撤离到操场，不得乘坐电梯，各班清点人数后上报。

earthquake_drill__confuser.text: 消防器材检查：每月检查一次灭火器压力表指针是否在绿色区域，过期灭火器需及时送检更换。

invoice_dispute.text: Disputed invoice: the supplier billed us twice for the March cloud hosting. Finance has put payment on hold and asked them for a corrected credit note before the end of the quarter.

invoice_dispute__confuser.text: Expense card limits: corporate cards have a monthly limit of 5,000 dollars; anything above that needs pre-approval from the department head.

pet_vaccine.text: 宠物疫苗接种：幼犬出生后六至八周首次接种，之后每隔三周加强一次，共三针，狂犬疫苗三月龄后接种，此后每年一次。

pet_vaccine__confuser.text: 猫咪饮食注意：成年猫每天喂食两次，避免喂食洋葱、巧克力和葡萄，保证充足饮水。

remote_work.text: Remote work policy: staff may work from home up to three days a week, must be reachable on chat between ten and four, and need manager approval to work from another country for more than two weeks.

remote_work__confuser.text: Office relocation: the team moves to the new building on the fifth floor next month; desks are assigned by department.
